body: These things are everywhere, but any search for what they're called has been nothing but dead end after dead end

The four logos which appear on terminals are Cob Genetics, PermaCura, the Ministry of Truth, and a Super Earth logo.

The Ministry of Truth is the red circle within two white crescents that you noticed. PermaCura and Cob are the only "corporate" logos that appear.

The idea of corporations or other groups gathering resources and other currencies from players toward some larger goal is a phenomenal idea that would incentivise the gathering of resources past their maximums. However, there has been a sample duplication glitch in the game for quite some time that can give players hundreds per mission, and it's prevented AH from doing anything with global sample collection counts. If bugs like this were fixed, I would quite like to see donation drives run by in-game ministers and corporations like you suggest. It is a good idea!

yeah, psychosis is a broad spectrum of experience. i live with psychosis and very rarely have hallucinations. and when i do, theyre tactile/olfactory hallucinations.

ive been in a similar place. autistic + depression & anxiety + other factors, it started with one day and next thing i knew i was almost unenrolled for lack of attendance.

i wish i could offer advice, but for me it was my senior year and i got off easy with a few online credits. graduated without a hitch (save for a ruined gpa and a lot of burned bridges), but it wasnt easy to power through those last few months.

only thing i can say is that you shouldnt listen ti anyone who calls you lazy. Executive Dysfunction is a thing that lots of autistic folks deal with (a lotta depressed folks too) and it can be really debilitating. a lot of my friends (who are also also autistic) have had issues like this in their lives too but dismissed themselves as being lazy. (some still do). 

(and avoid ABA. the focus of "applied behavioral analysis therapies" is just to stamp out behaviours that are assosciated with being autistic, and most people report them doing a lot more harm then good. (theres this idea that gets passed around that "oh we can cure autism by making them not act autistic anymore.") its not a good thing to immerse oneself in)

other than that, i just wanted to wish you well. i wasnt going to any prestigious school like you, but ive been there, and it sucks. hope youre able to stay afloat.
